children: Victoria, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) -
(OTCQB: AUUAF) ("
ALUULA
" or the "
Company

"), a leader in ultra-light, high-performance composite materials, today announced the appointment of Gary Smith to its Board of Directors, effective November 24, 2026. The Company also announced Peter Gustavson will retire from the Board and current director Christophe Dardel has been appointed as Chair of the Board, and Hannes Blum has been appointed as Vice-Chair of the Board.
These appointments reflect the Board's ongoing succession planning and add further global leadership experience in advanced materials, ingredient branding and commercialization.
Gary Smith Appointed to the Board

Mr. Smith brings more than 25 years of executive leadership experience building and scaling globally recognized ingredient brands and advanced materials businesses. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer of The LYCRA Company and Polartec, two of the world's most recognized performance material brands, and as Chief Executive Officer of Hatteras Yachts, where he gained experience in the technical aspects of high-end boat building. He also held executive leadership roles at Timberland. His experience spans advanced materials commercialization, global brand partnerships, technical textiles, military applications, and international manufacturing and supply chains.

Earlier in his career, Mr. Smith worked with McKinsey & Company, advising industrial and manufacturing companies on growth and transformation. He has maintained a strong focus on materials science throughout his career, including the development and commercialization of materials initially created for U.S. government applications that later became important dual-use products for Polartec.

An avid cyclist and outdoor enthusiast with a longstanding interest in sustainability and outdoor performance, Mr. Smith also brings an end-user perspective that complements his commercial and technical experience that align closely with ALUULA's culture and future direction.

"Gary's appointment strengthens the Board in areas directly aligned with ALUULA's strategy," said Sage Berryman, Chief Executive Officer and President of ALUULA. "He has led two of the world's best-known ingredient brands and understands how differentiated materials science can become an enduring source of commercial value. His experience across performance outdoor, defence and dual-use applications, global commercialization, and sustainability will be highly relevant as ALUULA scales its materials platform and expands into new markets."

"ALUULA has developed a differentiated materials platform with compelling performance and sustainability advantages," said Mr. Smith. "I am excited to join the Board and support the Company as it builds its global ingredient-brand position and expands the reach of its technology across performance, defence, and industrial applications."
Peter Gustavson Retires from the Board

Mr. Gustavson is retiring from the Board following a pivotal period in ALUULA's development. He played an essential role in establishing the Company's public-market foundation, including bringing together Bastion Square Partners, the capital pool company through which ALUULA completed its reverse takeover and became publicly traded.

During ALUULA's foundational years, Mr. Gustavson provided governance leadership, strategic guidance, and steadfast support as the Company progressed from an emerging materials innovator to a publicly traded advanced materials company.

"On behalf of the Board, management, employees, and shareholders, I want to sincerely thank Peter for his leadership and commitment to ALUULA," said Ms. Berryman. "Peter was instrumental in creating the public-company foundation that enabled ALUULA's growth. His judgment, support, and contribution during these essential formative years have been invaluable, and we wish him all the best in his retirement."

"It has been a privilege to be part of ALUULA's journey and to support the Company through its foundational years," said Mr. Gustavson. "ALUULA has exceptional technology, a committed team, and a significant long-term opportunity. I look forward to following its continued progress."
Christophe Dardel Appointed Chair and Hannes Blum Appointed Vice-Chair of the Board

The Board has appointed Christophe Dardel, a current director of the Company, as Chair of the Board. Mr. Dardel is a global materials executive with extensive experience commercializing advanced technologies and building premium ingredient brands. He previously served as President of DSM Dyneema, where he helped establish Dyneema® as a leading global business-to-business ingredient brand while supporting global growth, intellectual property strategy, and integration with brand and manufacturing partners.

"Christophe's appointment as Chair reflects the Board's confidence in his leadership and deep understanding of advanced materials businesses," said Ms. Berryman. "His experience scaling a premium UHMWPE brand and navigating global commercial partnerships will be highly valuable as ALUULA moves into its next phase of focused commercial execution and growth."

"I am honoured to assume the role of Chair and look forward to working with Gary, the other directors, and management as ALUULA advances its strategy," said Mr. Dardel. "The Company has created a distinctive materials platform and has a meaningful opportunity to build a globally recognized ingredient brand across multiple high-value markets."

The Board has also appointed Hannes Blum, a current independent director who has served on the Board since 2023, as Vice-Chair. Mr. Blum will continue to serve as Chair of the Compensation Committee and a member of the Governance Committee, and will work closely with Mr. Dardel to support the Board's leadership as ALUULA advances its strategy.

The Board noted that these changes are consistent with its ongoing succession planning and its focus on maintaining governance capabilities aligned with the Company's strategic priorities, including advanced materials innovation, ingredient-brand development, global commercialization, sustainability, defence and dual-use applications, and industrial scale-up.
About ALUULA Composites

ALUULA is an ultra-light, high performance and recycle-ready composite materials brand that enhances the performance of outdoor gear as well as commercial and industrial equipment. Proudly owned and manufactured on the Canadian west coast, ALUULA's innovation is driven by a deep understanding that equipment does not need to sacrifice performance for sustainability. ALUULA's materials are known for their unique construction capabilities and their ability to make products lighter, stronger, and more sustainable.
